rationale: Use the scaled correction for representative mesh selection because it preserves the original repeat geometry and changes only the pair-2 current amplitude deterministically. Pair2-rerun selection is retained as a sensitivity check and is not the figure-selection source.
usage_boundary: This package records median-representative remesh selection from the scaled current-corrected analysis. It should not be used as an instruction to generate a mixed-method final paper-analysis root.

retired_workflow.reason: The audited root used scaled-rescale remesh outputs but generated fixed_mesh outputs from a cache seeded only with selected m2m directories while common anatomical inputs were still linked from the base source root. This is not a clean selected-repeat fixed reference and is not suitable for final Repeatability paper figures.

fixed_median_recovery_workflow.reason: The standard repeatability_scaled fixed_mesh condition uses the original fixed mesh rather than the selected median remesh geometry. The remaining presentation dataset should seed fixed_mesh from each selected scaled remesh repeat as a full geometry/reference source and rerun only fixed_mesh; it should not introduce legacy-current simulation.
